# Clavis Encrypt 3.9.4

## ✨ A friendlier first five minutes

- The big button now says what it will do: **Encrypt now**, **Decrypt now** or **Verify now**, instead of "Execute".
- The very first password screen welcomes you and explains that a recovery key comes next.
- When files are encrypted, Clavis tells you what changed (they now end in `.enc`) and how to get them back. A new **Show in folder** button takes you straight to them.
- Counts read naturally: "1 file", "5 files", in the confirm and done messages.
- Available in all five languages.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
